headline: Plan comparison adds AI agents and tools, donations, and a rental platform
what: Wix's plans page now lists three new rows in its plan feature comparison: "AI agents and tools," "Donations and fundraising" ("Collect donations and run fundraising campaigns on your site"), and "Rental platform" ("List your rentals, set your prices and take reservations online"). Plan prices did not change.
who: Wix site owners and anyone comparing Wix plans, especially nonprofits, rental businesses, and people looking for built-in AI tools
seo_title: Wix plans now list AI agents, donations and fundraising, and a rental platform
seo_desc: Wix's plan comparison added three features on Oct 18, 2026: AI agents and tools, donations and fundraising, and a rental platform. Prices did not change.
